Ambedkar Nagar Hospital Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Senior Resident posts at Ambedkar Nagar Hospital?
faq.answer: The recruitment is through a walk-in interview. Candidates need to attend the interview on the specified dates. The walk-in interview is scheduled from 23rd September 2026 to 25th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS degree with a PG Degree/Diploma or equivalent in the concerned specialty recognized by the MCI and be registered with the Delhi Medical Council.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Senior Resident posts is 45 years. Age relaxation for PWD candidates will be as per Government of India rules.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 7 vacancies for the Senior Resident posts across various specialties like Anaesthesia, Medicine, Surgery, OBG, and Paeds.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a salary of Rs. 67700 per month, which is as per Level-11.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for these posts?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The mode of application is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly with the required documents.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at Ambedkar Nagar Hospital, New Delhi, 110062.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should candidates carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies, including ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if any), and category certificates (if applicable).

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for the Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Walk-in Interview followed by Document Verification.
